title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Choosing a Reputable Exchange

questions.text: Which of these is a red flag when choosing a cryptocurrency exchange?
options: No clear leadership and no published reserve audits
Two-factor authentication and cold storage for user funds
A verified withdrawal path to your local bank account
questions.explanation: An exchange operating with no clear leadership and no published reserve audits is a red flag: run the other way. The other three options are marks of a reputable exchange.

questions.text: True or false: Proof of Reserves audits prove an exchange actually holds its customers' deposited assets.
questions.explanation: True. A reputable exchange publishes regular Proof of Reserves audits proving it actually holds the assets its customers deposit.
